jobs.title: Senior HW Engineer – Signal and Power Integrity
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Every board Lumai builds has to run multi-gigabit links and feed high-current ASIC and FPGA rails. Getting those right before the board is fabricated is the difference between a working system and a respin cycle. This role owns the modelling, the stackups, the materials and the design rules that make it work, and has a direct say in the decisions that prevent the respin.

The Role

You will own signal and power integrity across our boards and packages. That means pre-layout channel studies that set routing topologies, stackups, materials and constraints; post-layout analysis of critical channels, including insertion and return loss, crosstalk, and eye and COM analysis with IBIS-AMI models; optimisation of vias, breakouts, connector launches and the transitions into our optical engines; and PDN impedance targets, decoupling strategies and DC drop analysis for high-current rails.

jobs.title: Senior HW Engineer – PCB Analog Design
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

At the centre of an optical computer sits a set of circuits that have to read, drive and hold steady some very small, very fast signals: photodetector front ends, laser and modulator drives, precision converter interfaces, and the quiet power and references underneath them. This role owns them, at board level, from the optical requirement through to the production build.

The Role

You will design the board-level analog and mixed-signal circuits that connect our electronics to light, and take them the whole way: specification, simulation, layout guidance, lab bring-up, characterisation and production. You will agree the optical requirements - optical power budgets, bandwidth, noise, linearity - with the photonics and system teams, and turn them into analog architectures and circuit specifications.

The whole team is artists in their own way; they think differently and create their own methods.

jobs.title: (Senior) Accountant / Buchhalter (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
DEINE ROLLE

Als unser (Senior) Accountant / Buchhalter (m/w/d) verantwortest du die laufende Buchhaltung der BIT Capital, eines regulierten Wertpapierinstituts mit 3 Mrd. € AuM und berichtest an unseren Finance Manager Lachezar Georgiev.

In deiner Rolle fokussierst du dich auf:

  • Buchhaltung von A bis Z. Du verbuchst Eingangs- und Ausgangsrechnungen in DATEV, steuerst die Zahlläufe, klärst offene Posten und führst die Anlagenbuchhaltung.

  • Der Monatsabschluss. Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss nach HGB vor und übergibst ihn bis zur zweiten Kalenderwoche an das Controlling.

  • Unterstützung beim Jahresabschluss. Du hilfst beim Jahresabschluss bis zum 20. Januar und interagierst mit dem Steuerbüro und unserer Wirtschaftsprüfung.

  • Reisekosten & Zahlungsverkehr. Du prüfst Reisekosten in Navan, gibst Zahlungen frei und behältst mit einer kurzfristigen Liquiditätsplanung den Überblick über die Zahlungsströme.

  • Automatisierung. Du baust Importe und Auswertungen, etwa aus Candis und Excel nach DATEV, und setzt KI dort ein, wo sie manuelle Arbeit ersetzt.

  • Meldewesen.

Every industrial company on our customer list, ZF, Schaeffler, Miele, Maersk, Lufthansa, is fighting the same challenge: margin erosion from tariffs, CBAM, and supply chains nobody fully understands anymore. We're not another SaaS tool competing for budget. We're the difference between a board that knows its cost exposure and one that finds out the hard way. As Account Executive, you own that conversation end to end, first call to signed contract, for the deals that actually move the needle.

Your tasks

  • Build and run your own outbound strategy across LinkedIn, phone, ema
